About Pro-delivery

About

The Pro-Delivery module simplifies the process of applying for academic documents like transcripts and certificates. Students can remotely request their documents, and ProGuide handles everything from the application to delivery. This hassle-free service saves time, eliminates long queues, and ensures students get their documents efficiently and stress-free.

How the Pro - Delivery works

Request for a Document

Student logs into the ProGuide portal, selects the desired document, and submits a request.

Agent Processing

The request is assigned to a ProGuide team agent who initiates and handles the document processing.

Approval

Once processed and approved, the document is finalized and ready for delivery.

Notifications to Students

The student is notified via WhatsApp, email, or other preferred channels that their document is ready for collection or delivery.
